q: The company raised the hourly _____ to attract more workers.
translation: 公司提高了时薪以吸引更多工人。

q: He tied a rope around his _____ before climbing the tree.
translation: 他在爬树前把绳子系在了腰上。

q: Please _____ here for a moment; the doctor will see you soon.
translation: 请在这里稍等片刻，医生很快会来见你。

q: The loud noise from the street _____ me up at six in the morning.
translation: 街上的嘈杂声让我在早上六点就醒了。

q: After dinner, my grandmother always takes a _____ around the neighborhood.
translation: 晚饭后，我祖母总是在附近散散步。

q: They hung a beautiful painting on the living room _____.
translation: 他们在客厅的墙上挂了一幅漂亮的画。

q: I realized I had left my _____ at home when I tried to pay for lunch.
translation: 当我准备付午餐钱时，才发现我把钱包落在家里了。

q: We spent the afternoon _____ through the old streets of the town.
translation: 我们整个下午都在小镇的老街上漫步。

q: All she _____ is a quiet place to finish her novel.
translation: 她只想要一个安静的地方来完成她的小说。

q: The country had suffered greatly during the long _____ that lasted for ten years.
translation: 这个国家在长达十年的战争中遭受了巨大损失。

q: The nurse checked on every patient in the hospital _____ before midnight.
translation: 护士在午夜前巡视了病房里的每一位病人。

q: Please put on a _____ coat before you go outside; it's freezing today.
translation: 出门前请穿上暖和的外套，今天很冷。

q: Without any _____, the power went out and the building was plunged into darkness.
translation: 没有任何警告，电力就中断了，大楼陷入黑暗。

q: Remember to _____ your hands before eating to avoid getting sick.
translation: 记得饭前洗手，以免生病。

q: Excuse me, could you tell me where the nearest _____ is?
translation: 不好意思，您能告诉我最近的洗手间在哪里吗？

q: Throwing away fresh food is a terrible _____ of money and resources.
translation: 扔掉新鲜食物是对金钱和资源的严重浪费。

q: My grandfather's old _____ still works perfectly after fifty years.
translation: 我祖父的旧手表在五十年后仍然运转完美。

q: Plants need plenty of _____ and sunlight to grow well.
translation: 植物需要充足的水和阳光才能生长良好。

q: In summer, nothing is more refreshing than a slice of cold _____.
translation: 夏天没有什么比一片冰凉的西瓜更解暑的了。

q: She _____ goodbye to her friends as the train slowly left the station.
translation: 火车缓缓驶离车站时，她向朋友们挥手告别。

q: Could you please show me the _____ to the nearest subway station?
explain: way n. 道路，方法，方式。
translation: 您能告诉我去最近的地铁站怎么走吗？

q: After being sick for two weeks, he still felt too _____ to go back to work.
translation: 病了两个星期后，他仍然感到太虚弱而无法回去上班。

q: The family's _____ was built over three generations through hard work.
translation: 这个家庭的财富是通过三代人的辛勤劳动积累起来的。

q: The police found a hidden _____ under the suspect's car seat.
translation: 警察在嫌疑犯的车座下发现了一件隐藏的武器。

q: She _____ a beautiful red dress to the party last night.
translation: 她昨晚穿了一条漂亮的红色连衣裙去参加聚会。

q: The _____ forecast says it will rain heavily tomorrow afternoon.
translation: 天气预报说明天下午将有大雨。

q: You can find more information about the event on our official _____.
translation: 你可以在我们的官方网站上找到更多关于这次活动的信息。

q: They invited over two hundred guests to their _____ ceremony by the lake.
translation: 他们邀请了二百多位客人参加他们在湖边举行的婚礼。

q: Every Saturday, my father spends an hour _____ the garden.
translation: 每个星期六，我父亲都花一个小时给花园除草。

q: I prefer to do my grocery shopping once a _____ to save time.
translation: 我喜欢每周采购一次食品杂货以节省时间。

q: The library is open until 9 p.m. on _____ but closes early on weekends.
translation: 图书馆工作日开放到晚上9点，但周末提早关门。

q: We are planning a short trip to the mountains this _____.
translation: 我们计划这个周末去山里短途旅行。

q: The magazine is published _____ and covers local news.
translation: 这本杂志每周出版一次，报道当地新闻。

q: The little girl began to _____ when she couldn't find her mother in the crowd.
translation: 小女孩在人群中找不到妈妈时开始哭泣。

q: Please _____ the package on the scale so we can calculate the shipping cost.
translation: 请在秤上称一下包裹的重量，以便我们计算运费。

q: He has lost ten kilograms in _____ since he started exercising regularly.
translation: 自从他开始定期锻炼以来，体重已经减了十公斤。

q: The host gave a warm _____ speech to thank all the guests for coming.
translation: 主人发表了热情的欢迎致辞，感谢所有来宾的到来。

q: The government provides social _____ programs to help low-income families.
translation: 政府提供社会福利项目来帮助低收入家庭。

q: She speaks English very _____ after living in London for five years.
translation: 在伦敦住了五年后，她英语说得很好。

q: The sun sets in the _____, painting the sky with beautiful colors.
translation: 太阳在西方落下，将天空染成美丽的色彩。

q: He prefers _____ movies to action films because he enjoys their storytelling style.
explain: western adj. 西方的，西部的。
translation: 比起动作片，他更喜欢西部片，因为他欣赏它们的叙事风格。

q: Don't forget to bring an umbrella; the ground is still _____ from last night's rain.
translation: 别忘了带伞，地面还因昨晚的雨而湿漉漉的。

q: We were lucky to see a blue _____ during our boat trip along the coast.
translation: 我们很幸运在沿海航行时看到了一头蓝鲸。

q: You can choose _____ flavor you like best from the menu.
translation: 你可以从菜单上选择任何你最喜欢的口味。

q: Bread is mainly made from _____ flour, which is grown on vast farms.
translation: 面包主要由小麦面粉制成，小麦种植在广阔的农场上。

q: The car's front left _____ was damaged when it hit the curb.
translation: 汽车的前左轮在撞上路边时损坏了。

q: You can call me _____ you need help, even late at night.
explain: whenever conj. 无论何时，每当。
translation: 无论何时你需要帮助，都可以打电话给我，哪怕是深夜。

q: She leaned close to _____ the secret in my ear so no one else could hear.
translation: 她凑过来在我耳边低语这个秘密，以免别人听到。

q: The bride wore a beautiful _____ dress that flowed behind her as she walked.
translation: 新娘穿着一件漂亮的白色礼服，走路时裙摆在她身后飘动。

q: It took me the _____ afternoon to clean and organize my room.
translation: 我花了整个下午来打扫和整理我的房间。

q: The river is over fifty meters _____ at this point, making it difficult to cross.
translation: 河流在此处宽达五十多米，很难渡过。

q: There is _____ concern about the environmental damage caused by plastic waste.
explain: widespread adj. 广泛的，普遍的。
translation: 人们对塑料垃圾造成的环境破坏普遍存在担忧。

q: His _____ is a doctor who works at the city hospital downtown.
translation: 他的妻子是市中心医院的一名医生。

q: We saw several _____ rabbits running through the field at sunset.
translation: 日落时分，我们看到几只野兔在田野里奔跑。

q: Our team needs to _____ the next three games to reach the finals.
translation: 我们队需要赢得接下来的三场比赛才能进入决赛。

q: A strong _____ blew through the valley, bending the tall grass.
translation: 一阵强风吹过山谷，吹弯了高高的草。

q: She sat by the _____ watching the rain fall on the empty street below.
translation: 她坐在窗边，看着雨落在下面空荡荡的街道上。

q: It was so _____ yesterday that several trees fell down in the park.
explain: windy adj. 有风的，多风的。
translation: 昨天风很大，公园里好几棵树都被吹倒了。

q: The restaurant offers a selection of local red _____ from nearby vineyards.
translation: 这家餐厅提供来自附近葡萄园的多种本地红葡萄酒。

q: The bird spread its _____ and flew high above the forest canopy.
translation: 鸟儿展开翅膀，飞到了森林树冠的高处。

q: The _____ of the competition received a golden trophy and a cash prize.
translation: 比赛的获胜者获得了一座金奖杯和一笔现金奖励。

q: Many birds fly south before _____ arrives to escape the cold weather.
translation: 许多鸟类在冬天到来之前飞往南方以躲避寒冷的天气。

q: The electrician replaced the old copper _____ with a safer modern cable.
translation: 电工用更安全的现代电缆替换了旧的铜电线。

q: With age comes experience and _____ that cannot be learned from books alone.
translation: 随着年龄增长而来的是经验和智慧，这些无法仅从书本中学到。

q: It would be _____ to save some money for unexpected expenses in the future.
explain: wise adj. 聪明的，明智的。
translation: 为未来可能的意外开支存一些钱是明智的。

q: I _____ you good luck in your new job and hope everything goes well.
translation: 我祝你在新工作中好运，希望一切顺利。

q: She _____ all her savings from the bank to buy her first apartment.
translation: 她从银行取出了所有积蓄来买第一套公寓。

q: The package should arrive _____ three to five business days.
translation: 包裹应该会在三到五个工作日内到达。

q: The old _____ sitting on the bench feeds the pigeons in the park every morning.
translation: 坐在长椅上的老妇人每天早上都在公园里喂鸽子。

q: I _____ what time the train leaves; we should check the schedule.
translation: 我想知道火车什么时候出发，我们应该查一下时刻表。

q: We had a _____ time at the concert; the music was absolutely amazing.
explain: wonderful adj. 精彩的，极好的。
translation: 我们在音乐会上度过了美好的时光，音乐简直太棒了。

q: The cabin was built entirely from _____ cut from the surrounding forest.
translation: 这座小屋完全是用从周围森林砍伐的木材建造的。

q: This sweater is made of pure sheep _____, so it keeps you very warm.
translation: 这件毛衣是纯羊毛的，所以非常保暖。

q: The factory employs over five hundred _____ from the local community.
translation: 这家工厂雇佣了五百多名来自当地社区的工人。

q: Traveling around the _____ has always been her biggest dream.
translation: 环游世界一直是她最大的梦想。

q: Don't _____ about the exam; you have prepared very well for it.
translation: 不要担心考试，你已经准备得很充分了。

q: His condition got _____ after he refused to take the medicine.
translation: 他拒绝服药后，病情变得更糟了。

q: That was the _____ storm the village had experienced in fifty years.
translation: 那是这个村庄五十年来经历过的最严重的暴风雨。

q: This antique vase is _____ several thousand dollars according to the expert.
explain: worth adj. 值得的 / n. 价值。
translation: 据专家说，这个古董花瓶值几千美元。

q: Volunteering at the animal shelter is a _____ experience that I highly recommend.
translation: 在动物收容所做志愿者是一次值得的经历，我强烈推荐。

q: Her efforts to help the homeless community made her _____ of everyone's respect.
explain: worthy adj. 值得的，有价值的。
translation: 她为帮助无家可归者所做的努力使她值得所有人的尊敬。

q: The soldier received a serious _____ to his left leg during the battle.
translation: 这名士兵在战斗中左腿受了严重的伤。

q: She _____ped the birthday gift in colorful paper and tied it with a ribbon.
translation: 她用彩纸包好生日礼物，并用丝带系上。

q: The two brothers often _____ with each other playfully on the living room floor.
translation: 两兄弟经常在客厅地板上 playful 地摔跤。

q: The old man's face was covered with _____, each telling a story from his long life.
translation: 老人的脸上布满了皱纹，每一道都讲述着他漫长人生中的一个故事。

q: She wore a silver bracelet around her _____ that her grandmother had given her.
translation: 她手腕上戴着祖母送给她的银手镯。

q: The famous author _____ his first novel when he was only twenty-two years old.
translation: 这位著名作家在只有二十二岁时就写了他的第一部小说。

q: As a full-time _____, she spends most of her day creating stories at home.
translation: 作为一名全职作家，她大部分时间都在家里创作故事。

q: I'm sorry, but you have the _____ number; there is no one here by that name.
translation: 抱歉，您打错电话了，这里没有叫这个名字的人。

q: The ancient city was surrounded by high stone _____ to protect it from enemies.
translation: 这座古城被高大的石墙包围，以保护它免受敌人侵袭。

q: The children ran down to the beach to play in the _____.
translation: 孩子们跑到海边去海浪里玩耍。

q: The dictionary contains over fifty thousand _____ and their definitions.
translation: 这本词典包含五万多个单词及其释义。

q: The museum displays ancient _____ of art from different civilizations.
translation: 博物馆展出了来自不同文明的古代艺术作品。

q: There are many _____ about climate change that scientists are studying.
translation: 科学家们正在研究许多关于气候变化的担忧。

q: The soldier had several _____ on his body after the long battle.
translation: 长时间战斗后，这名士兵身上有几处伤口。

q: She _____ her hands carefully before preparing dinner for the family.
translation: 她为家人准备晚餐前仔细洗手。

q: My father _____ the news every evening to stay informed about current events.
translation: 我父亲每天晚上都看新闻，以了解时事。

q: She always _____ a hat when she goes out in the summer sun.
translation: 夏天出门时她总是戴着帽子。

q: The team _____ almost every match they play this season.
translation: 这支球队本赛季几乎赢了每一场比赛。

q: He always _____ for good health and happiness at the New Year.
translation: 他总是在新年祝愿健康和幸福。

q: The teacher _____ the students not to run in the hallway.
translation: 老师警告学生不要在走廊里奔跑。

q: My grandmother _____ everyone who visits her home with homemade cookies.
translation: 我祖母用自制饼干欢迎每一个来她家的人。

q: It is getting _____ day by day as spring approaches.
translation: 随着春天的临近，天气一天比一天暖和。

q: After the illness, he felt much _____ than before and needed more rest.
translation: 病后，他感觉比以前虚弱多了，需要更多休息。

q: The new road is _____ than the old one, allowing two cars to pass easily.
translation: 新路比旧路宽，可以容两辆车轻松通过。

q: With experience, she became _____ in handling difficult customers at work.
explain: wise adj. 聪明的，明智的。
translation: 有了经验后，她在工作中处理难缠客户时变得更明智了。

q: The weather became _____ after the rain stopped and the sun came out.
translation: 雨停日出后，天气变得更潮湿了。

q: July is usually the _____ month of the year in this region.
translation: 七月通常是这个地区一年中最热的月份。

q: After the long illness, this was the _____ he had ever felt in his life.
translation: 久病之后，这是他一生中最虚弱的时候。

q: The Amazon River has the _____ basin in the world.
translation: 亚马逊河拥有世界上最宽的流域。

q: My grandmother is the _____ person I know; she always gives great advice.
explain: wise adj. 聪明的，明智的。
translation: 我祖母是我认识的最有智慧的人，她总是给出很好的建议。

q: This is the _____ summer we have had in ten years because of all the rain.
translation: 由于雨水太多，这是我们十年来最潮湿的一个夏天。

q: The store _____ him for shoplifting and called the police immediately.
translation: 商店警告他不要偷窃并立即报了警。

q: I _____ all my clothes by hand because I don't have a washing machine.
translation: 我用手洗了所有衣服，因为我没有洗衣机。

q: The movie was so sad that she _____ through the last half hour.
translation: 这部电影太感人了，她在最后半小时一直哭泣。

q: The athlete _____ herself before the competition to make sure she was not overweight.
translation: 运动员在比赛前称了体重，以确保她没有超重。

q: Many people _____ the historic event on television fifty years ago.
translation: 五十年前，许多人在电视上见证了这一历史事件。

q: I never _____ what to write until I sit down and start typing.
translation: 直到坐下来开始打字，我才不再好奇该写什么。

q: He spent the whole morning _____ the dirty dishes piled in the sink.
translation: 他整个上午都在洗水槽里堆积的脏碗碟。

q: I saw an old man _____ alone on the beach early this morning.
translation: 今天早上我看见一位老人独自在海滩上散步。

q: The children were _____ excitedly as the magician began his show.
translation: 魔术师开始表演时，孩子们兴奋地低语着。

q: She is _____ about whether to accept the job offer in another city.
translation: 她正在考虑是否接受另一个城市的工作邀请。

q: The team has been _____ hard to prepare for the championship game next week.
translation: 球队一直在努力训练，为下周的冠军赛做准备。

q: My mother is always _____ about my safety when I travel alone.
translation: 当我独自旅行时，我妈妈总是担心我的安全。
